failedRelease.step: Production accessibility, navigation, intent prefetch, and page recovery
failedRelease.case: site search keeps large-text results within the viewport at 320px

reproduction.cause: The project card used its long title's intrinsic minimum width. Search results could load before the page body, hiding the overflow in local checks.

fix.projectCards: Constrain the content column, wrap long text, and allow dates to wrap.
fix.searchResults: Wrap titles, type labels, and unbroken excerpt text within each result.
fix.regressions: Wait for all cards, use enlarged text with a wider font, and check text bounds as well as document width.
fix.assertionChanges: Retain viewport and keyboard focus assertions; add card text and result overflow assertions.

validation.note: Local WebKit used the cached WPE browser through a temporary launcher. CI uses the repository's standard browser installation.
